A real estate website proposal for Samantha Bender. Not a commissioned or verified brokerage website.

What was verified

The supplied Wix website identifies Samantha as a multimedia journalist. That portfolio informed the storytelling angle, not a claim about current licensing, sales history or real estate credentials. The user selected Columbus and Central Ohio as the intended market for this concept. No brokerage affiliation, license, awards, testimonials or transaction totals are asserted.

Sample properties

All property names, prices, dimensions, room counts and location assignments are fictional presentation data. Photos do not depict the named communities. Interior and exterior photographs are not asserted to belong to the same property. Replace them with verified listing data, approved photography, required brokerage disclosures and an appropriate MLS/IDX connection before launch.

Original source

Samantha’s original portfolio

Community references

Experience Columbus neighborhood guide and The Ohio State University neighborhood overview. Community descriptions concern places and amenities, not demographic suitability or promises about schools, safety or future values.

Photography and typography

Illustrative photography is sourced from Unsplash under its license. The editorial typeface is Libre Caslon Text, with the included SIL Open Font License. Supporting text uses a restrained system sans-serif. No stock icon library is used. Samantha’s portrait could not be downloaded from the source website; no substitute person was used.

Before launch

Confirm current professional details, obtain approval of the proposed copy, replace all sample listings, add required business disclosures and connect the enquiry form to an approved recipient. The current form only prepares a local draft. This prototype has not received an independent accessibility audit.
